personalDetails.bio: Senior Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience engineering high-performance web applications, WebGL digital twins, and resilient backend distributed systems. Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams, scaling cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP, and authoring open-source developer tooling.

timeline.description: Leading the core WebGL & Frontend Platform team in building real-time 3D telemetry dashboards and cloud simulation platforms for Fortune 500 clients.
bulletPoints: Architected a high-throughput WebGL rendering engine with Three.js & GLSL shaders, executing 60 FPS 3D scenes with 500k+ instanced mesh elements.
Engineered zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, Docker, and Kubernetes, decreasing release cycle durations from 3 days to 15 minutes.
Mentored senior engineers, conducted technical architecture reviews, and established company-wide TypeScript & React code standards.

timeline.description: Directed engineering of enterprise AI-assisted analytics platforms, real-time data streaming pipelines, and microservice backend clusters.
bulletPoints: Designed streaming LLM integration interfaces and Pinecone vector search databases, enabling sub-100ms context retrieval for 1M+ active queries.
Refactored monolithic legacy systems into Node.js/TypeScript microservices with Kafka event queues and Redis caching, cutting P99 latency by 70%.
Built dynamic data visualization suites with React, D3.js, and Framer Motion, boosting executive user engagement by 45%.

timeline.description: Engineered scalable SaaS applications, RESTful & GraphQL backend APIs, and secure multi-tenant authentication systems.
bulletPoints: Developed distributed Node.js/Express APIs backing cloud ERP solutions with OAuth2/JWT security and RBAC access controls.
Optimized MongoDB aggregations and PostgreSQL database indices, eliminating slow query locks under heavy concurrent loads.
Collaborated with product leadership to scope MVP specifications, delivering 12 client products on schedule.

timeline.description: Built responsive web applications, interactive UI components, and automated unit/integration test suites.
bulletPoints: Created custom UI component libraries with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 grid layouts.
Integrated third-party payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay) and Automated Email/SMS dispatch systems.

timeline.roleOrDegree: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science

bulletPoints: Published research paper on GPU-accelerated ray marching algorithms in web browsers.
President of University Computer Society & Lead Organizer of Annual National Tech Hackathon.

projects.title: CyberSphere: Real-time 3D Telemetry Simulation
projects.description: An interactive 3D WebGL telemetry portal featuring instanced particle networks, custom GLSL shader glows, and live node query capabilities.
projects.details: CyberSphere is a flagship WebGL simulation dashboard engineered with React Three Fiber, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS. It enables real-time visual monitoring of server clusters across global geographical points with GPU-accelerated 60 FPS performance.

projects.title: AuraAI: Agentic Knowledge Base & RAG Assistant
projects.description: A context-aware AI assistant leveraging OpenAI LLMs, Pinecone vector embeddings, and serverless streaming responses.
projects.details: AuraAI provides real-time streaming chatbot responses grounded in localized document embeddings. Features a glassmorphism control panel, conversation history persistence, custom prompt engineering templates, and vector similarity search.

projects.title: NovaCloud: Enterprise Kubernetes DevOps Console
projects.description: A centralized monitoring dashboard tracking container cluster health, microservice logs, and automated deployment pipelines.
projects.details: NovaCloud compiles telemetry across multi-region cloud servers. Features interactive metric heatmaps, real-time WebSocket alert triggers, container restart controls, and automated YAML manifest builders.

projects.title: MetaPay: Mobile Crypto Asset Wallet
projects.description: A React Native cross-platform cryptocurrency tracking and security transaction wallet with biometric authentication.
projects.details: MetaPay manages multi-chain crypto assets with dynamic chart analytics, biometric touch ID login, swipe-to-confirm token transfers, and automated dark theme switching.
